EVERGREEN FITNESS LLC — MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT
Demonstration version dated 1 October 2026. Original fictional document, not a contract template or legal advice.

MEMBERSHIP SCHEDULE
Club: Evergreen Fitness LLC, 18 Orchard Walk, Fairhaven, Example State, USA. Member: Alex Morgan. Home facility: Orchard Walk. Start Date: 1 November 2026. Initial Commitment: twelve months ending 31 October 2027. Monthly Dues: USD 45. Joining Fee: USD 25. Annual Facility Fee: USD 60, first collected 1 December 2026 and annually thereafter while membership remains active. All contact details in this demonstration are fictional.

1. Agreement and access
This Agreement consists of this Membership Schedule and the following membership conditions. The Member purchases personal, non-transferable access to the Home Facility during published opening hours, subject to reasonable capacity and safety restrictions. Premium classes, personal training and access to other facilities are not included. The Club will provide a separate order and price before enrolling the Member in an additional paid service. The Member must present an access credential and must not permit another person to use it.

2. Commitment and billing
The Initial Commitment is a twelve-month commitment, notwithstanding that Monthly Dues are collected in monthly instalments. The Joining Fee and first month's dues are payable on the Start Date. Subsequent dues are collected on the first day of each calendar month. The Member authorizes recurring charges to the payment method supplied at enrollment for dues and the charges expressly described here. Suspending a card or instructing a bank to stop payment does not itself cancel membership. The Club will provide an itemized statement on request and will investigate disputed charges promptly.

3. Failed payments and additional charges
If a payment is declined, the Club will notify the Member by email and allow seven days to update payment details before suspending access. A late fee of USD 10 applies once to a payment more than fourteen days overdue. The Club will not impose both a late fee and a separate failed-payment administration fee for the same instalment. The Annual Facility Fee contributes to general maintenance and is not a deposit. It is not prorated when the Member cancels during a membership year, except if the Club closes permanently or a refund is required by applicable law.

4. Renewal
After the Initial Commitment, membership renews automatically for successive twelve-month terms unless the Club receives cancellation notice at least thirty days before the current term ends. Monthly billing continues during a renewed term. The Club will email a renewal reminder forty-five days before the end of each term to the address held on the Member's account. Failure to use the facility does not prevent renewal. The Club must retain a record of renewal notices and will provide that record to the Member on request.

5. How to cancel
Cancellation notice may be submitted through the Membership page in the Member portal, by email to membership@evergreen.example, or by post to the Home Facility marked Membership Administration. No in-person visit is required. Notice must identify the Member and the requested end date. The Club will acknowledge receipt within three business days. If no acknowledgement arrives, the Member should contact the Club and retain the original email or portal confirmation. Timely cancellation at the end of a term ends access on the last day of that term and stops the next renewal.

6. Ending a commitment early
If the Member cancels before the end of a committed term, an early termination fee equal to two monthly dues payments applies. No early termination fee applies if the Club closes permanently, the Member relocates more than twenty-five miles from any Evergreen facility, or a medical practitioner certifies that the Member cannot safely use the facility for at least six months. The Member must provide reasonable evidence of a relocation or medical restriction; a diagnosis is not required. Charges already due for access before the effective cancellation date remain payable. Any mandatory cancellation rights are preserved.

7. Cooling-off and refunds
If the Member cancels within seven days after signing, the Club will refund the Member's Joining Fee and dues, less the proportion of dues attributable to days of access already provided. The Member may use the cancellation methods above. If the Club closes permanently without providing a reasonably equivalent replacement facility nearby, the Club will refund you for unused prepaid membership months within thirty days. Refunds will be returned to the original payment method unless the parties agree another method in writing.

8. Membership freezes
A Member may request one freeze of between one and three complete calendar months in each membership year by giving fourteen days' notice before the freeze starts. No dues are collected during an approved freeze. The committed term is extended by the number of frozen months, and the Club will confirm the revised end date in writing before the freeze takes effect. A freeze does not cancel membership. The Annual Facility Fee is postponed if its collection date falls during the freeze and becomes due on return.

9. Club rules and temporary closures
The Member must comply with posted equipment instructions and reasonable rules on conduct, hygiene and guest safety. The Club may remove a person who threatens others or intentionally damages equipment. Routine maintenance closures of up to three consecutive days do not extend the term. For a closure exceeding seven consecutive days, the Member may choose a corresponding extension or a credit for the unavailable days. The Club will notify members of planned closures when reasonably practicable and will not use house rules to introduce new financial charges.

10. Health and responsibility
The Member is responsible for choosing activities appropriate to their condition and should seek qualified medical advice where necessary. Exercise involves risks, including falls and equipment-related injuries. The Member acknowledges ordinary risks inherent in voluntary participation. Nothing in this Agreement excludes responsibility for the Club's fraud, deliberate misconduct, or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. The Club is not responsible for unattended personal belongings except to the extent required by applicable law. This section does not require the Member to indemnify the Club for the Club's own conduct.

11. Changes to dues and services
The Club may change these terms on thirty days' written notice, but an increase in Monthly Dues takes effect only at the beginning of a renewed term. The renewal reminder must state the new dues. The Member may reject an increase by cancelling before it takes effect without an early termination fee. Material reductions to the included facilities during a committed term entitle the Member to cancel without that fee. Optional new services are charged only if separately ordered.

12. Photographs and communications
The Club may take photographs at organized member events. You may opt out of event photography by notifying the event organizer before participation. The Club must obtain separate written permission before using an identifiable Member's image in paid advertising. Membership notices and billing correspondence will be sent to the contact details on the account; promotional emails are optional and have an unsubscribe link. The Club's separate privacy notice describes payment processors and retention of membership records. That separate notice is not reproduced in this demonstration and should be requested before enrollment.

13. Disputes and arbitration
The parties will first try to resolve a billing or membership complaint through membership@evergreen.example. Except for claims eligible for small claims court, covered disputes will be resolved by individual binding arbitration under the Example Consumer Arbitration Rules rather than a court trial, with no class proceedings. Members may opt out of arbitration within thirty days of signing by emailing arbitration@evergreen.example with their name, membership number and a clear statement rejecting arbitration. The Club will confirm receipt in writing. An arbitration opt-out does not cancel membership or change its financial conditions. The fictional arbitration rules are not supplied with this demonstration.

14. Notices and general provisions
A notice to the Club may be sent to the postal address in the Membership Schedule or the relevant email address stated above. A notice to the Member must be sent to the most recent address provided by the Member. If a provision cannot be applied, the remaining provisions continue to the extent permitted by law. A waiver on one occasion does not waive later compliance. This Agreement does not restrict rights that applicable consumer law makes mandatory. Any individually agreed variation must be recorded in writing and supplied to the Member.

SIGNATURE RECORD
Member: Alex Morgan (fictional). Club representative: Jamie Lee (fictional). Enrollment date: 25 October 2026. The parties acknowledge receipt of the Membership Schedule, membership conditions and cancellation contact details. This unsigned demonstration is provided only for product evaluation.

Product: Notes Plus, one personal account with synchronization across five devices and 100 GB storage. Annual Subscription Fee: INR 2,400, exclusive of applicable taxes, charged in advance. Trial: fourteen consecutive days from activation. These terms describe direct purchases only. Purchases from an app marketplace are governed by that marketplace's billing and cancellation terms, which must be reviewed separately.

1. Acceptance and account
By activating Notes Plus, you accept this Plan Schedule and these Subscription Terms. You must be able to enter into a binding agreement and provide an accurate email address. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and promptly notifying support@daylight.example of unauthorized access. You must not share a personal account as a pooled business account. References to 'Notes' mean documents, attachments and organizational metadata uploaded by you. 'Service' means the hosted application and its synchronization functionality, not a guarantee of uninterrupted access to every third-party network.

2. Trial and first charge
Unless you cancel before the fourteen-day trial ends, your trial automatically converts to a paid annual subscription and your payment method will be charged INR 2,400 plus applicable taxes. The activation screen and confirmation email state the trial end date and time in Indian Standard Time. A reminder will be emailed three days before conversion. If you cancel during the trial, no subscription fee is charged and you retain read-only access for seven days to export Notes. A payment authorization may be requested during activation but is not itself a subscription charge.

3. Annual renewal
Your paid subscription renews automatically each year unless you cancel through Settings, Billing, Cancel subscription before the displayed renewal date and time. We will email a reminder seven days before renewal, stating the amount and billing date. You authorize recurring collection through the payment mechanism approved at checkout, subject to any authentication and notification requirements applicable to that mechanism. We do not promise that every card or bank will support recurring payments. If collection fails, we will notify you and provide seven days to update payment details before restricting paid features.

4. Cancellation and access
You can cancel renewal at any time using account settings or by contacting billing@daylight.example from the registered email address. We will provide a cancellation confirmation showing the date paid access ends. Deleting the mobile application does not cancel a subscription. Cancellation during a paid period stops the next renewal and does not immediately remove paid access. If you cannot access your account, support will verify identity through proportionate account information; it will not ask for your full card number or password. Do not send sensitive payment credentials by email.

5. Refunds
Annual subscription payments are non-refundable after the paid period begins, except where applicable law requires otherwise or these terms expressly grant a refund. A service credit is not cash and cannot be transferred. If we discontinue Notes Plus without an equivalent replacement during your prepaid period, we will refund you for the unused portion of that period within thirty days. If you were charged twice for the same account and period, we will correct the duplicate charge after verification. Cancellation alone does not establish that a billing error occurred.

6. Taxes and invoices
Applicable GST or other taxes will be shown before checkout and on the invoice. If you request an invoice for a registered business, provide accurate billing details before the invoice is issued. We will correct an invoice where required by applicable law but cannot guarantee the tax treatment available to you. Bank charges or currency conversion fees imposed by your payment provider are your responsibility and are not subscription fees collected by Daylight. Promotional pricing applies only for the period stated in the offer; the renewal reminder will state the next applicable price.

7. Ownership and service license
You retain ownership of your Notes and all intellectual property rights you hold in them. You grant us a non-exclusive license to host, copy, transmit and reformat Notes solely to provide synchronization, search, backup and export for your account. That license does not authorize public advertising using private Notes or sale of their contents. You are responsible for obtaining permission to upload material owned by others. You may export your Notes in the available standard formats without purchasing a separate content license from us.

8. Privacy and service providers
We share personal information with payment processors, hosting providers and support vendors to operate the Service under contractual restrictions. We do not sell your private Notes or use their contents for marketing purposes. Our separate Privacy Notice explains categories of account information, hosting locations, retention, rights requests and grievance contacts; it is incorporated only for those subjects. The Privacy Notice is deliberately not included in this demonstration. These Subscription Terms alone do not describe the complete processing of personal information, and the reader should obtain that notice before relying on a privacy assessment.

9. Export, downgrade and deletion
After paid access ends, your account enters a thirty-day read-only export period. During that period, you can download Notes but cannot upload new content above the free storage allowance. At the end of the export period, Notes exceeding that allowance may be permanently deleted after a further seven-day email warning. A request to close the account starts the deletion process described in the Privacy Notice and may end the export opportunity sooner if you expressly request immediate closure. You should maintain independent copies of important records; synchronization is not an archival guarantee.

10. Acceptable use
You must not use the Service to distribute malware, attempt unauthorized access, harass others or store material you have no right to possess. Automated use must stay within published rate limits designed to protect availability. We may temporarily restrict an account where reasonably necessary to investigate a security incident or a material breach. We will explain the restriction unless disclosure would compromise security or violate a legal requirement. You may appeal by writing to support@daylight.example, and an individual who did not make the original decision will review the appeal.

11. Service changes and availability
We may maintain, update or replace features, but will give at least thirty days' notice before removing a core paid feature without a reasonably equivalent replacement. Planned maintenance will normally be announced in the application. We do not guarantee that the Service is error-free or that every requested integration will remain available. If a core paid feature is permanently removed during your paid term, you may cancel and receive a prorated refund of unused subscription fees. Temporary interruptions do not automatically qualify for a refund under this section.

12. Price and terms changes
We may modify these terms on thirty days' notice by email, identifying material changes and their effective date. An increase to the annual subscription price applies only at your next renewal, never retrospectively during a prepaid period. If you disagree with the renewal price, cancel before renewal. A change that materially reduces your rights during the current paid period permits cancellation with a prorated refund for that period's unused portion. Continued use after an effective date indicates acceptance only to the extent permitted by applicable law.

13. Warranties and liability
We will provide the Service with reasonable care and skill. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we do not warrant suitability for storing the only copy of critical medical, financial or legal records. Our aggregate liability arising from the Service is limited to subscription fees paid by you in the preceding twelve months. This limitation does not apply to fraud, deliberate misconduct or liability that cannot lawfully be limited. Neither the license in your Notes nor this section transfers responsibility for our own unlawful conduct to you.

14. Ending the service and disputes
You may end your account through Settings or written support request. We may terminate for a material breach after giving a reasonable opportunity to remedy it, except where immediate action is necessary to prevent harm or comply with law. The export arrangements above apply unless continued access is legally prohibited or would create a security risk. Complaints should first be sent to grievance@daylight.example with the account email and relevant invoice number. These terms do not prevent access to any mandatory consumer complaint or dispute-resolution mechanism.

15. General and contact
Notices to Daylight may be sent to legal@daylight.example or the Provider address in the Plan Schedule. Notices to you will be sent to your registered email address. If a provision is invalid, the rest continues where legally possible. A failure to enforce a provision once is not a permanent waiver. These terms and the Plan Schedule constitute the subscription agreement for the direct-purchase product described above; a more specific written offer prevails only for the subject it expressly addresses. No fictional address or contact in this demonstration accepts actual support requests.

PARTIES AND EFFECTIVE DATE

Otherwise the general conditions govern legal and ownership matters, Schedule B governs fees and payment milestones, and Schedule A governs deliverable specifications. Each party will nominate one representative authorized to approve day-to-day project decisions; only the signatories may change fees, ownership or liability provisions.

The Designer will perform the Services with reasonable professional care and provide progress updates each Friday during active production. The Client must supply approved copy, brand assets and access credentials within five business days of request. The Client remains responsible for product claims, legal notices and final publishing instructions.

The fixed fee includes the deliverables and revision rounds in Schedule A. Email approval by the nominated signatories is sufficient. The Client's silence does not approve an additional charge. The Client will review each submission and provide consolidated feedback through its project representative. Final acceptance is subject to the Client's approval that the visual presentation meets its brand expectations. The fixed fee excludes stock images, paid fonts, travel and third-party hosting. An expense is reimbursable only if the Client approves its amount in writing before commitment, and the Designer supplies a receipt or equivalent record. All intellectual property rights created by the Designer specifically in the Final Deliverables transfer to the Client upon creation, regardless of payment. The Designer will sign reasonable confirmatory documents consistent with that transfer, at the Client's expense. The Client's payment obligations remain enforceable separately from ownership. The transfer does not include Background Materials, preliminary concepts rejected by the Client, or third-party assets. The Designer must identify material Background Materials before incorporating them into a Final Deliverable and may not transfer a third party's rights without permission.

'Background Materials' means the Designer's pre-existing code, reusable utilities, methods and general-purpose design components. The Designer retains those materials and grants the Client a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use them only as embedded in the Final Deliverables. Third-party assets remain subject to their own identified license terms. The Designer may display publicly launched Final Deliverables in the Designer's portfolio after the Client's public launch, but must remove confidential information and unpublished business metrics. This permission does not allow use of the Client's name as an endorsement of unrelated services.

Each party must protect the other's non-public business information using reasonable care and use it only to perform this Agreement. Confidential Information excludes information already known without restriction, independently developed, publicly available without breach, or lawfully obtained from another source. A party may disclose information to professional advisers and approved personnel who need it and are bound by confidentiality obligations. Required legal disclosures are permitted after advance notice where lawful. These duties last two years after termination, with trade secrets protected for as long as applicable law requires.

The Client may also terminate for convenience on seven days' written notice. The deposit is credited against accepted deliverables and approved expenses, and any excess is returned to the Client. The Designer will hand over paid-for project records and stop incurring new expenses after notice, except commitments the Client has approved in writing.

The Designer determines working methods, provides their own equipment and receives no employee benefits under this Agreement. The Designer may perform services for other clients during the project provided Client Confidential Information is protected and agreed milestones are met. The Designer may use an assistant only with prior written Client approval and remains responsible for that assistant's work and confidentiality. Neither party may bind the other to a third-party contract. Nothing requires the Designer to work exclusively for the Client or prevents general use of professional skills after completion.

Formal notices must be emailed to the parties' notice addresses with a copy by ordinary post to the address last confirmed in writing; email receipt must be acknowledged or otherwise evidenced. The parties will first try in good faith to resolve disputes through their signatories. Governing law and the court location must be completed by the parties before an actual engagement; this demonstration deliberately supplies no legal selection. Amendments must be written and signed. Provisions intended by their nature to survive, including accrued payment obligations, ownership and confidentiality, survive termination.

SCHEDULE A — STATEMENT OF WORK
A1. Deliverables: one responsive five-page marketing website comprising Home, About, Services, Case Study and Contact; one desktop and mobile layout per page; a component style guide; and source files in the agreed repository. A2. Process: discovery workshop, one design concept, two consolidated revision rounds, implementation and browser checks in current Chrome, Firefox and Safari. A3. Exclusions: ecommerce, account systems, copywriting, multilingual content and ongoing maintenance. A4. Client inputs: final copy, logo files, image licenses and hosting access. A5. Target dates: concept 16 November, implementation preview 7 December, planned launch 18 December 2026, subject to timely inputs. A6. Functional checks: navigation, contact form delivery to the nominated inbox, keyboard access to navigation and no horizontal overflow at agreed mobile widths. Visual approval remains governed by the review condition above.
